proposals.before: When the amnesty had been proclaimed they followed the imperial procession to the Palace of Virtuous Longevity to perform the long-life celebration rite, with the address: "The emperor, your subject So-and-so, says: Heaven blesses ruler and parent, bestowing this difficult old age; on this auspicious spring day years and virtue are renewed.
proposals.after: When the amnesty had been proclaimed they followed the imperial procession to the Palace of Virtuous Longevity to perform the long-life celebration rite, with the address: "The emperor, your subject So-and-so, says: Heaven blesses ruler and parent, bestowing this ageless longevity; on this auspicious spring day years and virtue are renewed.
proposals.reason: 難老 means freedom from aging / ageless longevity, not “difficult old age”.

decisions.reason: 錫茲難老 uses the classical blessing 難老 (freedom from aging / ageless longevity); “difficult old age” wrongly reads 難 as “difficult,” and “ageless longevity” correctly renders the phrase.
